say: Stack Overflow against ChatGPT, with two lives each.
ChatGPT opens with its inhale, and Stack Overflow answers with a correction.
Stack Overflow parries, but the compaction slab still flattens it.
Its unified beam takes ChatGPT down to a third of its health.
One more push sends ChatGPT off the edge of the page, and it loses a life.
Back with full health, ChatGPT keeps inhaling and compacting.
Stack Overflow holds on until ChatGPT goes over the edge again.
